entries.title: Return browser control with one click
entries.body: Return control now hands the browser back directly, with a sharing notice visible before you press it. Saved sites show their saved status instead of asking you to remember them again. In Settings, separately allow a saved site for future tasks across your projects, or turn that permission off without removing the sign-in.

picture.alt: A task browser under your control, with a sharing notice and a Remember choice before one-click return
